summary: Construction labor on real property is not subject to Tennessee sales tax; the contractor pays tax on its materials and can't charge it to the customer as tax.

notes: Applies to improvements and repairs alike. A contractor-dealer selling materials without installing them makes retail sales (goods.general). summary: A delivery charge for goods not subject to Tennessee sales tax is not taxable.

citations.title: TN DOR Sales and Use Tax Manual (August 2026), Delivery Charges
citations.quote: However, when an item purchased is not subject to Tennessee sales and use tax, the delivery charge is not subject to sales or use tax.

summary: Local option sales tax applies to food and food ingredients at the full local rate.

citations.title: TN DOR Notice 23-09, 2023 Sales Tax Holiday for Food and Food Ingredients
citations.quote: All retail sales of food and food ingredients made before August 1, 2023, and after October 31, 2023, will be subject to sales tax.

citations.title: TN DOR Notice 17-20, Sales Tax on Food and Food Ingredients (October 2017)
citations.quote: As of July 1, 2017, food and food ingredients are subject to a reduced sales and use tax rate of 4%, plus the applicable local tax rate.

summary: Local tax applies to food and food ingredients at the full local rate unless the city or county has adopted a reduced local rate on food and food ingredients.

conditions.when: The city or county where the sale is sourced has adopted a reduced local rate on food and food ingredients (for example the City of Hendersonville, 2.25% from 2025-02-01; Davidson County and the cities in it, 1.75% from 2026-11-01), or a city has exempted food from its city tax rate under Pub. Ch. 917 (2024) so only the county rate applies
No reduced local food rate has been adopted where the sale is sourced

citations.title: TN DOR Notice 24-07, Certain Cities and Towns May Adopt Reduced Sales Tax Rate on Food and Food Ingredients
citations.quote: Exempt from the city tax rate the retail sale of food and food ingredients within the city or town.

citations.title: TN DOR Notice 24-07, Certain Cities and Towns May Adopt Reduced Sales Tax Rate on Food and Food Ingredients
citations.quote: The reduced tax rate or exemption applies only to tax periods beginning on or after October 1, 2024.

citations.title: TN DOR, Important Notice: Local Sales Tax on Food and Food Ingredients - City of Hendersonville (2024-12-20)
citations.quote: Effective February 1, 2025, the new reduced local sales tax rate for food and food ingredients sold in the City of Hendersonville is 2.25%.

citations.title: TN DOR Notice 26-19, Local Sales Tax on Food and Food Ingredients - Davidson County (September 2026)
citations.quote: Effective November 1, 2026, the new reduced local sales tax rate for food and food ingredients sold in Davidson County is 1.75%.

notes: The reduced local food rates are set place by place and announced in Department notices; this rule can't say which places have one. Pub. Ch. 917 (2024) lets a city lower or exempt only its 'city tax rate' (the part above the county rate); Davidson County's 1.75% (Notice 26-19, citing Tenn. Code Ann. 67-6-702) is a county-level reduction. Single-article local cap still applies to food items.

citations.title: TN DOR Notice 17-21, Sales Tax on Prepared Food (October 2017)
citations.quote: Prepared food is subject to the general state sales and use tax rate of 7%, plus the applicable local tax rate.

notes: Notice 17-21 says its text was updated 'to reflect law changes' making seller-mixed items that need cooking (raw marinated meat, raw-egg mixtures) food; the earliest copy read with that text is the Wayback Machine's of 2018-08-02, so the rule starts there. No Tennessee guidance naming take-and-bake pizza or meal kits was found; an assembled item without raw animal food is prepared food by the mixed-ingredients test.

summary: During the 2023 food tax holiday, local tax didn't apply to assembled food with raw animal food the buyer must cook; other seller-assembled food stayed taxable.
